scope: Recorded replacements of legacy Host/backend regressions; incomplete retirement ledger, not release certification

preservedOrStrengthenedAssertions: The caller owns the only candidate source store in split and single-file modes
Every returned logical artifact has exactly one source and matching SHA-256
Sink-specific memory identities do not become portable artifact paths
A native record remains present in the emitted declarations
Compiled managed Outer size is 96 and nested/suffix offsets are 32/64
Actual managed source compilation treats warnings as errors
An over-aligned by-value argument is rejected before any candidate write while its pointer form is emitted
All three imports reject unproven long double by-value returns before any candidate write
GNU and musl asset RIDs remain distinct
A real worker-backed initial request creates a generation cache entry and the unchanged request hits it
A new Host using the same cache and configuration executes a newly registered processor or backend
An unfingerprinted contribution disables affected generation reuse
The new contribution is present in the published owned manifest with exact content hash
Frozen node collections and stable-ID lookup retain the original node after the builder changes
Callable arguments and declaration children cannot be mutated through IList
Interop parameter and field snapshots remain independent of caller lists and record replacements
Managed enum/external field projections retain their snapshots and the identical frozen native ABI
Every exported Contracts namespace is checked, including nested public types
Public fields, events, base types, interfaces, generic arguments and pointer/byref/array element signatures are inspected
Contracts and Runtime cannot reference other BGCS implementation assemblies

remainingRetirementGates: Map remaining legacy Host/configuration/metadata/formatting capabilities and tests to exact neutral implementations and receipts
Verify callback plus C++ status/owned results and worker-only advanced Clang extensions
Verify original-storage ref/Span aliasing and count-copy scope correction with real native calls
Complete frozen consumer constant/reference inputs through Host cache and publication
Resolve remaining configuration inventory gaps including borrowed member presentation and external function-table layout
Delete replaced facade/configuration/metadata/backend surfaces and frontend project reference
Run actual architecture command with zero violations without exceptions
Rebuild full current neutral suites and public API snapshots after retirement

limitations: Requires one existing unambiguous friendly operation
Variation forwarding is on context and static facade; independent named-view variations are not inferred

additionalNeutralCapabilities.feature: Explicit module-lifetime borrowed results and C receiver members
additionalNeutralCapabilities.scope: Windows x64/CoreCLR, all three imports and Runtime package/source; source uses static facade and single file
limits: Address validity through actual supplying-module unload is an explicit UserAsserted native protocol.
Disposal releases a module lease and never frees the borrowed native object.
Owner/call-bound references, arbitrary mutable native globals and module-borrowed callback composition remain separately unsupported.
